title: Spex Machina Drift Report
description: A drift report filed by an implementer who found a spec defect during task implementation. Written to drifts/drift-<bead-id>.json; never a spec edit. Triaged in the authoring loop by /drift-workflow: /drift validates and verdicts the report and applies the accepted correction, /spec-review audits, /mint makes the deliberate mint-or-refresh decision; the report is deleted in the same PR.

bead.description: The bead id whose implementation surfaced the defect.

node.description: Identity hash of the spec node whose contract carries the defect.

files.description: Spec files involved, repo-relative (the defective leaf and any file it contradicts).

claim.description: The defective statement, quoted or precisely paraphrased, with its location.

authoritative_source.description: What the implementer believes is the truth, and where it is established (a sibling leaf, a requirement, observed constraint). For a hole (unspecified case): the case that is undecided.

evidence.description: Why the claim is wrong or undecidable: the concrete contradiction, the input the contract does not decide, or the dependency seam that does not exist.

blocking.description: True iff the defect is in the bead's OWN contract (its leaf, its implements chain, its uses seams) and makes the task ambiguous or unimplementable — the implementer cannot produce a valid result. False for defects in neighbors that do not gate this bead's work.

proposed_fix.description: Optional: the implementer's suggested correction. Advisory only — the authoring loop decides.
